name: Name on the One
why_it_works: A name sung five times on a strong beat sticks without the viewer trying. The brain stores rhythm before meaning, so {{brand}} gets remembered as a sound, and people hum it later without knowing why.

hook.pattern: Open cold on the sung brand name over a hard downbeat, no intro, then the one-line promise.
examples: We wrote {{brand}} a theme song. Hum along.
Fifteen seconds. One song. You will hum {{brand}} tonight.

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Business name as sung, 2-3 syllables sings best (4 at most)

variables.name: signature_item
variables.description: The one thing they are known for, capitalized because it opens a sung line, 4 syllables or fewer

variables.name: rhyme_line
variables.description: Short lowercase phrase that rhymes with the signature item, 5 syllables or fewer so the whole line fits one breath

variables.name: neighborhood
variables.description: Street or neighborhood people know, 5 syllables or fewer

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Simple reason to come in this week, capitalized, 7 syllables or fewer because it is sung

beats.purpose: hook (line A): sung brand name twice on the downbeat

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of the {{brand}} storefront sign at golden hour, bold front-on framing, warm light, sign fills the upper third, street at {{neighborhood}} softly blurred

beats.purpose: line B: what they do, rhymed

visual.prompt: Close-up of hands at work on the signature service or dish at {{brand}}, quick rhythmic motion, warm practical light, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16

beats.purpose: line A again: name twice plus the place

visual.prompt: Vertical wide shot inside {{brand}}, regulars laughing together, bright natural window light, brand colors visible, eye-level framing

beats.purpose: line A button: last sung name plus offer

music.feel: bright bouncy pop jingle, four-on-the-floor kick, handclaps on 2 and 4

craft.notes: Four sung lines in an A-B-A-A shape: A lines carry the name, the B line carries the signature item. Aim the stressed syllable of {{brand}} at the downbeat each time it is sung: five times in 15s (twice in the hook, twice in line three, once in the button). Title placement: the name is the first and last thing sung, so it bookends. The B line uses one end rhyme ({{signature_item}} / {{rhyme_line}}) so the ear has a reason to stay. Keep every sung line to one breath, about 8 syllables. Tempo/feel: 104 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick with handclaps on 2 and 4; leave a short rest before each sung name so it hits like a stamp. Beat seconds are a guide (about ±1s): the edit is cut to the track, so aim the stresses at the downbeats rather than promising exact bar placement.

do_not: Bury the brand name mid-line where it lands on a weak beat
Use a melody that sounds like a famous jingle or real song
Cram more than one selling point into 15 seconds
